name: Demo Video Atlas
description: A demonstration entry showing how a concise free-video listing appears in the directory.
review: This is placeholder editorial copy for the framework. Replace it with an original, fact-checked review covering catalog focus, usability, playback, advertising, account requirements, privacy, and regional availability.

name: Demo Open Stream
description: A second sample used to test ranking, compact cards, and category page generation.
review: Use this field for a useful first-hand editorial assessment rather than a rewritten homepage. Separate confirmed facts from subjective observations and state when information could not be verified.

name: Demo Studio Pass
description: A placeholder subscription service with room for pricing and library notes.
review: A production review should explain the subscription structure, cancellation path, supported devices, video quality, update frequency, and any material limitations visible during testing.

name: Demo Member Library
description: A sample premium listing used to demonstrate tags and ranked alternatives.
review: Replace this placeholder with a balanced assessment and avoid unverifiable superlatives. Where an outbound link is monetized, label the relationship and use the appropriate link relation.

name: Demo Live Room
description: A demonstration live platform entry with an interactive-service label.
review: For a real live-platform entry, document browsing access, registration requirements, payment or credit mechanics, moderation tools, and the experience on desktop and mobile.

name: Demo Stage Now
description: A second live-service placeholder for testing longer category lists.
review: Real entries should be checked in the target market because access, performers, pricing, and features may vary by country and device.

name: Demo Creator Club
description: A creator-platform sample with subscription and direct-support tags.
review: Production copy should focus on the platform's discovery tools, subscription controls, payment options, privacy settings, and creator verification practices.

name: Demo Fan Space
description: A neutral placeholder for a direct-to-fan platform listing.
review: Keep real platform reviews distinct from individual creator profiles. Explain discovery, pricing, privacy, and account management in plain language.

name: Demo Immersive View
description: A sample immersive listing with space for hardware compatibility notes.
review: A complete entry should state supported headsets, browser or app requirements, resolution options, streaming or download formats, and refund limitations.

name: Demo Story Shelf
description: A text-first sample entry for stories, serialized writing, and community features.
review: For real story platforms, assess navigation, tagging, author tools, moderation, accessibility, registration, and whether premium access changes the reading experience.

name: Demo Audio After Dark
description: An audio-first placeholder used to test cross-format categorization.
review: Real audio listings should document catalog organization, playback controls, download support, creator attribution, pricing, and accessibility features.

name: Demo Social Match
description: A sample community listing with space for geographic and account notes.
review: A production review should discuss registration, profile visibility, discovery tools, messaging limits, verification, safety controls, pricing, and data deletion options.
